entry_points.summary: Haiku lookup worker frontmatter: model, description, tool allowlist (WebFetch, WebSearch, Bash, Read, Grep, Glob)
STATUS-headed Markdown envelope: Answer, Provenance, Unresolved, optional Raw artifact pointer
Regex guard compiled once; tested before every Bash call; match forces STATUS: refused mutation_blocked
3 KB total response cap; overflow to lookup-cache/<sha256>.raw; normalized query rule
freshness_ts is UTC retrieval time; stale cache >24h mtime forces confidence: low
ok/partial/refused semantics; three refusal categories: mutation_blocked, out_of_scope, auth_missing
Six provenance fields; commands always verbatim, never truncated in provenance section
high=authoritative+no-interpolation; medium=inference or contradiction; low=stale or single-source
Formal checklist: STATUS first, section order fixed, <=3 KB, no raw dumps, verb-blocklist before Bash

invariants: First output line is exactly STATUS: ok|partial|refused.
Sections appear in fixed order: Answer, Provenance, Unresolved, optional Raw artifact pointer.
Total response including STATUS and all sections is <=3 KB.
Answer never dumps raw HTML, JSON, or YAML.
Bash commands are checked against verb-blocklist before execution; never sanitized and run.
Provenance records Bash commands verbatim, never truncated.
No tool dispatch other than the whitelist: WebFetch, WebSearch, Bash, Read, Grep, Glob.
gotchas: 4xx/5xx fetches become STATUS: partial and get one fallback attempt before giving up.
Matched mutation patterns refuse with mutation_blocked; do not sanitize and execute.
Authenticated endpoints without secrets refuse as auth_missing; no env-var sniffing.
Raw artifact pointer used for overflow at z-harness/lookup-cache/<sha256>.raw (gitignored, mkdir -p if absent).
Grep and Glob are in the tool allowlist for repo-local lookups; older exports may not reflect this.
WebFetch link-follow depth is <=2 (original + at most one hop per source); deeper pagination noted in Unresolved.
Verbatim commands in provenance can push response over 3 KB; full response then goes to raw artifact file.
